title: Chapter 145 Suo Yong'S Concerns
content:
Chapter 145 Suo Yong'S Concerns

Then, Wang Shuo came to the place where the city wall was built.

At this time, Yan Fujie and Xiao Laoteng were busy on the city wall with a dozen masons.

It can be seen that Xiao Laoteng is speeding up the work.

From time to time, he would scold the slow masons.

The reason why he was so anxious was that they had to build the city wall before they could learn to draw defense symbols from him.

Complete the agreement with Wang Shuo.

And the longer it takes to complete, the less cost-effective it will be for him.

Because he teleported here and completed the task, he had to pay a fee to the craftsman organization that asked him to do the task.

His fee was calculated by the hour, and the craftsman organization also charged by the hour.

Therefore, the sooner he returned, the more he earned. Anyway, he and Wang Shuo were talking about a package price.

"Mr. Architect, do you want to have a cup of tea and take a rest?" Wang Shuo saw that with the current progress, the construction period would definitely be completed before dusk, and he couldn't help but joked.

Xiao Laoteng gave Wang Shuo a resentful look.

How could he not understand that this was clearly Wang Shuo's doing, deliberately not letting these bricklayers learn to draw defensive runes from him first.

"Don't worry, Lord, I'm still very strong." He kept working and replied in a stiff tone.

Wang Shuo laughed and ignored him.

At this time, Suo Yong ran over and reported to Wang Shuo about the recent changes in the territory.

"Lord, our craftsman camp has built a total of 3 residential buildings in the past few days, which can provide accommodation for 120 people."

"I heard from Duan Wenxi that there are new refugees coming every day, right?"

"Yes, so we are still building new residential buildings. At the current growth rate, our village will soon reach 200 people."

Wang Shuo learned from the village head group that most of the villages have more than 200 people, and many have already synthesized silver village building orders.

Wang Shuo felt a sense of loss in his heart.

These crises one after another made it difficult for him to find time to collect population on a large scale, which was really uncomfortable.

There is no other way, we have to wait until we have dealt with the bandits.

At this time, Suo Yong continued: "In addition, the current buildings in the territory include the Lord's Mansion (village-level administrative center), blacksmith shop, tailor shop, carpentry workshop, and central square."

Wang Shuo thought about it, and he had seen most of these buildings.

There are very few buildings, and you can see them all at a glance. Seeing these sparse buildings, Wang Shuo pondered for a while, thinking of the private ownership system that will be implemented soon, Wang Shuo pondered:

"You have to speed up the time to build houses, and make sure that everyone has a place to live. It is only a stopgap measure for new refugees to live in tents."

"Also, build a canteen and public toilets as soon as possible, and then build a grocery store."

Thinking that they have been living on their old capital and have no new food sources, this may also become a hidden danger.

Wang Shuo continued, "The reclamation of farmland and the construction of breeding farms, these two things must be implemented as soon as possible."

"Also, 20 arrow towers and 20 energy towers must be built tomorrow morning..."

"Lord, this... I am just the manager of the craftsman camp..."

Suo Yong hesitated, showing a constipated expression.

Is this a desire for promotion?

Wang Shuo looked at Suo Yong meaningfully, and said with a smile: "Suo Yong, you see, the territory is still in its infancy, there are not so many red tapes, you are all the initial contributors to the territory, and you will definitely not be treated unfairly in the future..."

Suo Yong's pupils widened when he heard it, and he hurriedly explained: "Lord, I don't mean that, I mean, I am also forced to do it, I have no experience in this area."

"The main thing is that I can't take care of so many things by myself!" He blushed and said hurriedly.

So that's it!

Wang Shuo thought it was a big deal!
